new_code_contract_constants.classification: numerical execution contract only; not a physics tolerance or forward-error theorem
new_code_contract_constants.root_isolation_arithmetic: exact dyadic rationals derived from f64 bits

authority.rule: This V2 contract freezes callback-free event algebra, exhaustive roots of the authoritative event carrier, raw-boundary versus certificate semantics, restart latching, and transition/history ordering. It changes no equation, coefficient, chart state order, family label, formula authority, scientific claim, reference, grid, seed, or existing solver rtol/atol.

inherited_preflight.reuse_rule: Valid only while the required preimplementation parent and controlling bytes are unchanged.

batch.failure_isolation: each member returns a complete typed result; one failure cannot erase or relabel another member
forbidden: shared reductions that affect a member trajectory
NaN-only failure signaling without a typed member status
batch.one_thread_vs_many_threads: same build and inputs must produce byte-identical member states, statuses, event records, and ordering
batch.ordering: result order exactly equals input order
batch.parallelism: only across independent members; each member trajectory is serial

domain_semantics.accepted_samples: Ordinary accepted samples require every g_cert>=0. A selected root or latched restart sample may have a raw margin in its frozen event-value zero band but must satisfy every certificate margin.
domain_semantics.epsilon_initial: For a nonzero requested interval, use the same epsilon_g formula from the first certified carrier subsegment for that predicate. For a zero-length request, epsilon_initial=event_atol+event_rtol*max(1,abs(g_raw(y0))).
domain_semantics.events: Domain events locate g_raw=0. Changing rtol/atol may change the certificate but MUST NOT replace the event expression by g_cert or shift the physical boundary.
domain_semantics.history: Store both raw and certificate margins for every declared predicate.
initial_state: If g_raw < -epsilon_initial for any predicate, return INITIAL_DOMAIN_VIOLATION before stepping.

If |g_raw| <= epsilon_initial, classify it as an initial boundary neighborhood. The first certified one-sided carrier sign decides whether a directed event fires, is latched toward the interior, or is a continuum-zero boundary.
A restart receipt uses its stored latch and exact root bytes; it is not reclassified as an external initial condition.
domain_semantics.projection: chart_project_checked uses g_cert>=0 as its inequality postcondition; it does not clip or solve inequalities.
domain_semantics.raw_margin: g_raw(y) is exactly the expression in the built-in registry. The physical boundary is g_raw=0.
domain_semantics.zero_length_request: After initial-state validation, tau_end bits equal tau_start bits returns COMPLETED with one initial sample and no event scan or transition. An out-of-domain initial state still fails.

event_dense_carrier.authority: The event carrier, not an arbitrary callback and not undocumented diffsol interpolation internals, defines RF-02C event roots.

dyadic_certification.failure: EVENT_CARRIER_CERTIFICATE_FAILURE; stop without selecting a root or returning an unvalidated post-step state.
dyadic_certification.nonadvancing_step: tau1 == tau0 returns NONADVANCING_ACCEPTED_STEP; it is never treated as a dense interval.
dyadic_certification.nonfinite_rule: Any non-finite endpoint, midpoint, RHS, defect, AST value, or polynomial coefficient returns EVENT_CARRIER_NONFINITE before root selection.
dyadic_certification.subdivide: Otherwise bisect at the exact dyadic midpoint, obtain solver.interpolate(mid), evaluate chart RHS there, and certify both children.

event_dense_carrier.scope_of_exhaustiveness: Every distinct real root, including repeated and tangential roots, of every armed compiled event polynomial on every certified subsegment is enumerated. No claim is made for roots of an arbitrary external callback because such callbacks are forbidden.
event_dense_carrier.solver_step: One accepted diffsol BDF step [tau0,tau1], with theta=(tau-tau0)/(tau1-tau0) increasing from 0 to 1 in the actual integration direction.

endpoint_data: solver dense state at each dyadic endpoint
chart RHS evaluated at the same endpoint
state_carrier.fixed_evaluation: Use the displayed term order. Root state is evaluated once at the chosen theta and its bytes are stored for restart.

event_expression_language.coefficient_compilation: Substitute each state component by the authoritative piecewise cubic carrier; compile the AST to ascending polynomial coefficients. Convert every resulting f64 coefficient to its exact IEEE-754 dyadic rational before root counting.
event_expression_language.evaluation_order: AST post-order, lhs before rhs, ordinary binary64 operations with no reassociation
event_expression_language.parameter_rule: Only named scalar chart parameters frozen in the request may appear. RF-02C uses only kappa in a domain expression.
event_expression_language.registry_canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, separators=(comma,colon), ensure_ascii=true

candidate_pipeline: Compile every armed built-in event expression on every certified carrier subsegment.
Enumerate all isolated roots and CONTINUUM_ZERO intervals using root_isolation.
Apply direction and latch eligibility without deleting tangential candidates from the detector evidence.
Deduplicate the same event root at carrier joins using exact ownership before any floating tie test.
Choose the earliest eligible root in the actual integration direction.
Group different eligible roots within tau_tie as simultaneous; choose lower numeric priority then stable registry order.

event_definition.callback_free: expr MUST be a closed event-expression AST from event_expression_language.
event_definition.public_user_events: UNSUPPORTED_IN_RF02C; return UNSUPPORTED_EVENT_EXPRESSION before solver entry.

root_sample.history: append exactly once after requested samples strictly before the root
root_sample.state: piecewise-Hermite state at the selected representable theta; evaluate once, store exact f64 bytes, no projection, no epsilon nudge
validation: trigger exact and f64 residual <= epsilon_g

status_semantics.accepted_prefix_rule: A segment or trajectory may be accepted without reaching the requested endpoint only when its returned prefix and terminal record satisfy this contract.

byte_identity_encoding.rule: Restart compares tau bits and state SHA before any numerical reevaluation.
byte_identity_encoding.state_sha256: SHA-256 of state components in frozen state order, each encoded as unsigned u64 big-endian IEEE-754 to_bits

history.recollapse_timing: The expanding root sample exists once. Its event record is ordered before its transition record. The contracting segment references the same start sample index but does not append another sample.
history.separation_rule: This is normalized geometry history only. H(tau), cosmic time, mean scale factor, thermodynamics, rays, and observables remain separate adapters.

integration.rule: Projection is never silently inserted. Any enabled projection mode must call chart_project_checked and stop on a typed failure.
integration.single_trajectory_execution: serial, one O(1) FFI call, no Python inner-step callback

acceptance_tolerances.atol: Bind to the caller's already-selected background solver atol.
acceptance_tolerances.rtol: Bind to the caller's already-selected background solver rtol.

checked_route.algorithm: Repeated one-step calls to the unchanged Gauss-Newton candidate; no clamping, line search, hidden fallback, or inequality projection.

constraint_scaling.normalized_residual: R_k = max_i abs(c_i(y_k)) / scale_i; R_k = 0 when the chart has no equality constraints.

convergence.success: Finite candidate, all iteration records finite, normalized equality residual accepted, and physical-domain predicate accepted.
convergence.zero_iteration: Allowed only when the input already satisfies all postconditions.

domain_slack.rule: Inequalities are checked but never projected or clipped.

monotonicity.rule: Do not rescue a non-monotone candidate with backtracking in RF-02C.

checked_route.name: chart_project_checked

raw_candidate_route.backward_compatibility: Keep its existing signature and numerical update. Do not interpret a returned finite vector as successful projection.
raw_candidate_route.name: chart_project

restart.evaluation_frequency: Rearm is determined on every certified carrier subsegment by exact isolation of the stored latch-threshold polynomial; accepted internal solver endpoints are additional assertions, not the sole rearm detector.
history_continuity: route identity, state schema hash, parameters, tolerances, and event registry hash must match
restart tau/state bits must equal the previous root record
concatenation appends no duplicate restart-initial sample
segment, sample, event, and transition sequence numbers continue monotonically
the first post-restart sample, if any, is strictly later in the actual integration direction

rearm_rules.+1: rearm only after an accepted internal solver endpoint has g_raw < -stored epsilon_g
rearm_rules.-1: rearm only after an accepted internal solver endpoint has g_raw > stored epsilon_g
rearm_rules.0: rearm only after an accepted internal solver endpoint has abs(g_raw) > stored epsilon_g
rearm_rules.one_shot_transition_event: never rearm after its transition; consumed=true

restart.source: stored accepted event-root tau and stored root-state f64 bytes
within_step_rearm: For direction -1 isolate p(theta)-epsilon_g and rearm at the earliest exact crossing from the zero band to p>epsilon_g.
For direction +1 isolate p(theta)+epsilon_g and rearm at the earliest exact crossing from the zero band to p<-epsilon_g.
For direction 0 isolate both threshold polynomials and rearm at the earliest exit on either side.
After rearm, later raw roots in the same accepted BDF step are eligible and remain subject to exact all-root enumeration and direction filtering.
A CONTINUUM_ZERO interval never rearms by itself.

algorithm: If the polynomial is identically zero, emit CONTINUUM_ZERO for that subsegment; do not fabricate infinitely many point roots.
Compute gcd(p,p_prime), square-free decomposition, and multiplicity of every distinct factor over Q.
Use an exact Sturm sequence to count and isolate every distinct real root on theta in [0,1]. Strict sign-change sampling is forbidden as a completeness argument.
Own interior subsegment roots by (0,1]; only the first carrier subsegment may own theta=0. This removes duplicate roots at dyadic joins.
Refine each rational isolating interval until its theta bounds round to the same or two adjacent binary64 values.
Among those representable candidates choose the theta with the smallest exact |p(theta)|; ties choose the smaller theta. Compute tau_root=(tau1-tau0).mul_add(theta,tau0).
Accept only if the exact polynomial residual and the binary64 AST residual are both within the frozen event-value tolerance; otherwise return EVENT_ROOT_REPRESENTATION_FAILURE.
root_isolation.arithmetic: Exact rational arithmetic over dyadic coefficients obtained from f64 bits. num-bigint/num-rational already occur in the locked dependency graph; adding them directly must not update third-party versions.

direction_classification.0: eligible for either crossing and for an even-multiplicity tangency
direction_classification.continuum_zero: No isolated event fires. Keep the event latched while its expression remains in the zero band; if a later certified segment leaves toward the forbidden side, the shared boundary is the event root.
direction_classification.final_endpoint: Use the last nonzero left-side sign: -1 is eligible when arriving from positive values, +1 when arriving from negative values, and 0 is eligible.
direction_classification.initial_endpoint: For an unlatched root neighborhood at theta=0, use the first nonzero right-side sign: -1 fires only when the carrier enters negative values, +1 only when it enters positive values, and 0 fires. Interior departure is latched, not terminated.
direction_classification.interior_root: Use exact signs on the open intervals immediately before and after the isolated root as theta increases in the actual integration direction.
direction_classification.tangential: Always enumerated with multiplicity; it does not fire a -1 or +1 event.

event_value_tolerance.binary64_computation: Compute epsilon_g once in the displayed order using binary64, store epsilon_g_bits, and treat that stored value as an exact dyadic rational for latch-threshold root isolation.
event_value_tolerance.coefficients: p_k are exact dyadic coefficients of the selected atomic event polynomial on the selected certified subsegment.
event_value_tolerance.freeze: Store epsilon_g in the event and restart-latch records. Never recompute it from a later state.

excluded: kinetic, collision, ray, observable, inference, timing, GPU, and RF-03+ lanes

stop_rules: Any arbitrary callback or user-supplied executable root function => UNSUPPORTED_EVENT_EXPRESSION.
Any event carrier that cannot satisfy its dyadic midpoint certificate by depth 24 => EVENT_CARRIER_CERTIFICATE_FAILURE.
Any polynomial root that cannot be represented within both exact and f64 event-value tolerances => EVENT_ROOT_REPRESENTATION_FAILURE.
Any event/restart/history behavior not mechanically selected by V2 => BLOCKED_P0_SEMANTICS.
Any equation, coefficient, state order, chart-label, scientific-authority, reference, grid, seed, or existing solver-tolerance change => STOP_SCOPE_VIOLATION.
Any need for a transition outside the single frozen Type-IX identity/phase transition => BLOCKED_BY_UNRESOLVED_SPEC.
Any projection candidate that cannot satisfy the checked postconditions without changing the frozen Gauss-Newton update => BLOCKED_P1_PROJECTION.
Do not start RF-03+, merge, mark ready, or make performance/publication/inference claims.

supersedes.rule: V2 is complete and authoritative. Implementations MUST NOT merge ambiguous V1 event/restart/history prose with V2.

exact: root state has H_bar = 0 within the frozen event-root tolerance

requirements: Rust trajectory compared at shared requested samples to the independent Python exceptional chart
g and Omega diagnostics remain within the checked execution contract

allowed.state_map: identity; reuse the stored root-state f64 bytes without reevaluation

atomic_recollapse_order: Truncate the accepted BDF step to the selected root.
Append the root sample exactly once with phase=expanding and sample_kind=event_root.
Append the type_ix_recollapse event record referencing that sample index.
Apply the identity state map and append the transition record at the same tau/sample index; event sequence precedes transition sequence.
Close the expanding segment with TRANSITION_REQUIRED and expose the exact stored tau/state plus a consumed one-shot latch.
If the requested endpoint lies beyond the root, start the contracting segment atomically at the exact same tau/state bytes without appending a restart-initial sample.
If the root is the requested endpoint within tau_tie, append event and transition, return COMPLETED_AT_TRANSITION, and create no continuation segment.
All later samples carry phase=contracting. The recollapse event is permanently consumed after this transition.
forbidden_automatic_transitions: any state reconstruction not explicitly frozen above

verification.exact_oracle_rule: Evaluate exact fixed points and closed-form trajectories with a 64*eps_f64 algebraic slack before integration comparison.
verification.negative_selector: pytest -q tests/rf02c/test_background_execution_contract.py -k 'tamper or unverified or invalid or mutation or hostile or restart or failure_isolation'
required_groups: callback-free expression registry and degree ceiling
piecewise-Hermite carrier certification and fail-closed depth exhaustion
exact all-root isolation with crossing, multiple, tangential, endpoint, backward-order and continuum-zero cases
raw event boundary invariant under certificate tolerance changes
frozen event-value tolerance and restart-latch rearm sides
recollapse event -> transition -> optional atomic restart history order with one root sample
verified native provenance and tamper negatives
checked projection success and each typed failure
single-member vs batch and one-thread vs many-thread determinism
composite receipt and randomized JVP receipt

trajectory_comparator.scope: code-contract differential budget, not a global scientific forward-error theorem
